title: How Much Does a Kashmir Trip Actually Cost? (2026 Budget Breakdown)
subtitle: Transparent realistic costs for flights, hotels, cabs, houseboat stays, gondola tickets & food.
excerpt: Planning a trip to Kashmir but confused by wild online quotes? Here is the exact, honest budget breakdown for Budget, Mid-Range, and Luxury travelers for a 6-day holiday.

contentSections.heading: Cost Component 1: Flights to Srinagar (SXR)
contentSections.content: Direct flights from Delhi or Mumbai generally fluctuate by season. Booking 45-60 days in advance yields the most reliable rates.
bulletPoints: Mumbai / Bengaluru - Srinagar Return: ₹9,500 – ₹16,000 per person

contentSections.heading: Cost Component 2: Stays & Houseboats (Per Night for 2 People)
contentSections.content: Kashmir offers an array of stays from authentic homestays to five-star mountain resorts.
bulletPoints: Deluxe 4★ Mountain Resort with central heating: ₹4,500 – ₹8,500 / night
Ultra Luxury 5★ (Khyber Gulmarg / Vivanta Srinagar): ₹18,000 – ₹45,000 / night

contentSections.heading: Cost Component 3: Private Dedicated Cab & Transfers
contentSections.content: Due to scenic mountain distances, having a dedicated cab with a verified local chauffeur is standard and ensures complete comfort.
bulletPoints: Sedan (Dzire/Etios) for 6 Days: ₹14,000 – ₹18,000 total (includes fuel, driver & tolls)

contentSections.heading: Summary: Total Estimated Cost for 2 People (6 Days / 5 Nights)
contentSections.content: Excluding airfare, a comfortable mid-range holiday (3-4★ stays, private cab, daily breakfast & dinner, houseboat night) typically costs ₹34,000 to ₹48,000 total (approx. ₹17,000–₹24,000 per person).
contentSections.highlightQuote: SafarTrails provides transparent, bundled pricing with zero hidden surcharges on ground.
